feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 June 2026 4:17am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 06 June 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure affecting the south of the British Isles slowly tracking east and filling, frontal zone affects the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

East or southeast 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the south to start, decreasing 4 or 5 through the morning, becoming variable 2 to 4 in the afternoon, becoming west or southwest 4 or 5 in the evening, backing south-southwest overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the south to start, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle soon becoming isolated. Becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South-southwest 4 or 5, quickly increasing 5 or 6 occasionally 7, veering west or southwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough, becoming slight overnight into Monday.


##Weather##

Mainly fair to start, then occasional rain or drizzle soon arriving, clearing overnight into Monday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
